claims: Ben McCollum is the head men's basketball coach for the University of Iowa.
Ben McCollum was hired in March 2025 to lead the Hawkeyes.
Ben McCollum was a Division II coach at Northwest Missouri State.
Ben McCollum led Iowa to the NCAA Tournament in his first season (2025-26).
Ben McCollum's hiring was announced as the 23rd head coach in Iowa men's basketball history on March 24, 2025.
Ben McCollum previously served as the head coach at Northwest Missouri State.
Ben McCollum won four NCAA Division II national championships at Northwest Missouri State (2017, 2019, 2021, 2022).
Ben McCollum led the Hawkeyes to a 20-win season in 2025-26.
Ben McCollum led the Hawkeyes to a NCAA Tournament berth in his debut year.
Fran McCaffery coached Iowa men's basketball for 15 seasons.
Jan Jensen is the head coach for the Iowa Hawkeyes women's basketball team.
Jan Jensen was named as Lisa Bluder's replacement in May 2024.
